# Town of Westminster municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 26; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Town of Westminster, Town Report 2025-2026, 'Town of Westminster - Elected Officials' list (with term-expiration dates): Selectboard -- Craig Allen (term to 2028); Jason Perry (to 2027); Real Bazin (to 2026); Charles Lawrence (to 2027); Stephen Major (to 2026)

Town of Westminster, certified return of votes for the March 3, 2026 annual election (machine tally, certified by the election inspectors; posted on the town clerk's page): SELECTBOARD 3 YEARS -- Stephen Major 230; SELECTBOARD 2 YEARS -- Real J. Bazin, Sr. 207

Town of Westminster, Selectboard page (current): 'Members: Craig Allen, Chair; Real Bazin, Vice Chair; Jason Perry, Clerk; Stephen Major, Member; Vacancy' -- Lawrence's seat is vacant (the town posted a selectboard-member vacancy notice in April 2026); no appointee is published

Town of Westminster, certified return of votes for the March 3, 2026 annual election (machine tally, certified by the election inspectors; posted on the town clerk's page): MODERATOR OF THE TOWN -- David Major 234

Town of Westminster, Town Report 2025-2026, 'Town of Westminster - Elected Officials' list (with term-expiration dates): 'Town Clerk: (3 Year) Mildred Barry' with term expiring March 2027 -- the seat did not stand in 2026
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): names Mildred Barry as Westminster's Town Clerk
Town of Westminster, Town Report 2025-2026, 'Town of Westminster - Elected Officials' list (with term-expiration dates): 'Town Treasurer (3 Year) Pauline O'Brien' with term expiring March 2027

Town of Westminster, official ballot for March 3, 2026: the treasurer race is for the 'Remaining 1 year of a three-year term' with Mildred (Millie) Barry the printed candidate -- O'Brien departed before her term ended

Town of Westminster, certified return of votes for the March 3, 2026 annual election (machine tally, certified by the election inspectors; posted on the town clerk's page): TREASURER -- Mildred (Millie) Barry 239. Barry holds the clerkship and the treasurership on one record

sources.note: Town of Westminster, Town Report 2025-2026, 'Town of Westminster - Elected Officials' list (with term-expiration dates): Board of Listers -- Jacklyn Atwood (term to 2027), with two seats expiring in 2026

Town of Westminster, certified return of votes for the March 3, 2026 annual election (machine tally, certified by the election inspectors; posted on the town clerk's page): LISTER 3 YEARS -- John E. Ewald 210. The LISTER 2 YEARS REM race drew 15 scattered write-in votes with no name tallied, so no winner is recorded for the third seat. Ewald also holds a justice of the peace seat on the same record

Town of Westminster, certified return of votes for the March 3, 2026 annual election (machine tally, certified by the election inspectors; posted on the town clerk's page): COMMISSIONER OF CAMPBELL FUND (3) -- Karen Walter 228, with 14 scattered write-in votes and no other name tallied: only Walter is recorded as elected to the three one-year seats in 2026

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists eleven Westminster justices of the peace: Matt Conklin, Frances (Nancy) Dalzell, John Ewald, Elizabeth Harlow, Susan Harlow, Charles Lovell, Adrienne Major, Susan Roman, Peggy O'Toole, Jeanette Staley, and Sarah Waldo. Conklin's full form, Matthew Conklin, follows the town's certified 2026 tally
